描述_EN: when they were accidentally unearthed centuries later, they became treasured objects of antiquarian scholars and collectors. both the vessel and the lid carry an inscription consisting of two pictographs. metalworkers in ancient china made a great variety of food and wine containers in bronze for ritual use. each vessel had a specific name according to its shape and function. it has a lid, which shows it was used to store wine. this bronze wine vessel is called a fangyi in chinese. these incised pictures are the clan sign of the owner of the vessel. these vessels were buried with the dead.
描述_ZN: 当它们在几个世纪后被意外地挖掘出来时，它们成了古董学者和收藏家的珍品。 该器皿和盖子上都有一个由两个象形文字组成的铭文。 古代中国的金属工匠用青铜制作了大量的食物和酒的容器，供祭祀使用。 每个容器根据其形状和功能都有一个特定的名字。 它有一个盖子，这表明它是用来储存酒的。 这个青铜酒器在中国被称为扇形器。 这些刻画的图画是该器皿主人的宗族标志。 这些器皿与死者埋在一起。
